description: AT-26 Xavante FAB 4508 (c/n 73047290) donated from the Recife depot, restored in the university workshop and unveiled 30 Sep 2006 (AeroFórum; Monolito Nimbus). An AeroFórum query in 2021 asked whether it had gone back to the FAB, but the Feb 2026 compilation still lists it at ULBRA.
